items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: played with Oliver and Louie and all that stuff, too. ... Well, it was wonderful, wonderful days, I mean. Yeah. It was wonderful days. Chicago, Chicago.

ctx.x: What about Red Happy? When did he come up with? Who was that? Red Happy. I heard once he was like a kid with Louie and the Reform school. Well yeah. Louie's age or older?
Well I think Happy was older than Louie. Yeah, he's an older boy than Louie. What was his real name?
